sourceRecords.title: BlueFloat Joint Venture Partner Acquires Full Ownership of 10 Floating Wind Projects in UK, Italy
sourceRecords.sourceText: OffshoreWIND.biz reported that Nadara would acquire BlueFloat Energy 50 per cent stake in their joint venture floating offshore wind projects in the UK and Italy. The source states that Nadara would take full ownership of ten projects, including Broadshore, Bellrock, Sinclair and Scaraben in Scotland and six proposed projects in Italy.
